caption: The drawing is composed of three orthographic projections of a wooden tavern table: a top view, a front view, and a side view, all rendered in fine, evenly spaced black lines on a light tan or off-white background. The top view, shown in the upper left, consists of a large rectangle representing the table surface, with an inner dashed rectangle indicating the support structure beneath; measurements are marked along the perimeter. Below the top view is the front view, depicting two turned wooden legs and a rectangular stretcher connecting them, with proportional measurements between key points. To the right, the side view shows the same table with two legs and a similar stretcher arrangement, also annotated with lengths and heights, as well as the table top’s thickness. Titles and descriptive text, such as "WORKING DRAWING OF TAVERN TABLE," "BROOKLYN MUSEUM," and "DINING ROOM OF DANBURY HOUSE BUILT 1775," are located in the upper right corner, specifying the creator, scale, and context of the object. The drawing features no color aside from the color of the paper and the dark lines of ink or pencil.
title: Table
